title: One leg tucked
hook: A simple model can compare exposed surfaces.

knows: Birds have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The model shows one leg outside the feather outline and one tucked inside. Reducing exposed leg area can reduce one route of heat loss in this toy comparison; real heat balance depends on more factors.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: In this toy model both legs lose heat equally when exposed. If one is tucked under feathers, how many legs remain exposed?

claims.text: The stage is a simplified schematic and the scenario is stipulated rather than observed.
A bird has two legs. If both are tucked inside the modeled insulated layer, how many legs are exposed? Both modeled legs are inside the layer, so no legs remain exposed.
